title: Transport Coordinator
description:

**Job Description**
* Should have a valid 4 wheeler driver’s license (Preferably HGV)
* Should know the road traffic regulations
* Communicating with other department staff and outside company personnel on the transport facilitation
* Maintaining Statutory records of the vehicle registration, maintenance, FC, insurance documents \&etc as a valid

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Singapore Hardwares \& Interiors is a specialized provider of designer hardware and interior hardware solutions for residential spaces. The company offers a one\-stop destination for customers looking to create or enhance their dream home interiors with quality fittings and finishes. Focused on both style and functionality, Singapore Hardwares \& Interiors curates products that complement modern and traditional design preferences. Team members collaborate closely with clients, designers, and suppliers to deliver coordinated interior hardware solutions that support thoughtful, well\-planned living spaces.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mylapore, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day installation and execution of interior hardware and related works at customer locations. The role includes coordinating with clients, designers, and installation teams, ensuring that work is completed on schedule and in accordance with quality standards and safety guidelines. The Site Supervisor monitors material usage, checks measurements and fittings, and resolves on\-site issues promptly to maintain smooth operations. Daily tasks also include reporting progress, documenting site activities, and supporting adherence to project plans and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Experience supervising on\-site interior or construction work, including coordination of installation teams and vendors.
* Knowledge of interior hardware, fittings, and basic construction practices, with the ability to read and interpret drawings or layout plans.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple sites or tasks and meet project deadlines.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for interacting professionally with clients, colleagues, and contractors.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality, safety, and cleanliness at the worksite.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mylapore and travel to nearby project locations as required.
* Prior experience in interior projects, hardware installation, or site supervision is preferred.
* Relevant technical or vocational qualification in civil, interior design, or related field is an advantage.

title: Process Manager HWS/Care
description:

title: Stores Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, serving communities across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. Over 1 million people have benefited from Sevalaya’s work in education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare. The organization is professionally managed and guided by a committed Board of Trustees with diverse professional backgrounds and a shared passion for social development. Sevalaya operates with the philosophy of “Love All Serve All,” offering opportunities for team members to contribute meaningfully to social change. Interested individuals can learn more about Sevalaya’s initiatives through its presence on major social media platforms.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Stores Manager role based in Tiruvallur. The Stores Manager will oversee day\-to\-day store operations, including inventory management, stock receipt and issuance, and maintenance of accurate records and documentation. The role involves coordinating with procurement and program teams to ensure timely availability of materials, monitoring stock levels, and implementing controls to prevent losses and pilferage. The Stores Manager will be responsible for maintaining a clean, organized, and safe store environment, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. The role also includes supervising store staff, supporting audits, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency and support Sevalaya’s service\-focused mission.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Store Management skills, including inventory control, stock handling, and basic documentation.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills to support internal stakeholders and ensure timely, accurate material support for projects.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for coordinating with procurement, program teams, and auditors.
* Candidates should possess Retail Loss Prevention skills, including implementing checks to minimize shrinkage and ensure asset protection.
* Relevant experience in store or warehouse management, preferably in nonprofit, educational, healthcare, or rural development settings.
* Ability to use basic computer applications (e.g., spreadsheets, inventory software) and maintain clear, organized records.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity, and reliability in handling materials and documentation.
* Minimum of a diploma or bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, commerce, or a related field is preferred.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.
   

  

 EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

title: Lead Manufacturing Specialist - Operation Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Responsible for the oversight and operational excellence of production value streams. The role focuses on driving Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) performance through the deployment of advanced lean manufacturing strategies. Candidate will lead cross\-functional transformation initiatives, mentor operational teams, and influence supply chain and processes to achieve long\-term productivity and scalability. This role needs to lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, optimize process flow, reduce waste, and improve overall operational performance.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Managerial: Own SQDC performance for defined value streams; translate high\-level business objectives into actionable operational strategies.
* Integrated Planning: Lead production planning cycles in coordination with Supply Chain and Contract Management to ensure 100% on\-time delivery.
* Operational: Architect and execute lean roadmaps. Move beyond basic tool application to driving systemic cultural change through Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.
* Continuous Improvement Expert: Spearhead high\-impact Kaizen events, Action Workouts (AWO), and organizational problem\-solving initiatives to eliminate structural waste.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Serve as the primary operational partner for Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure seamless production, New Product Introductions (NPI) and engineering change integration.
* Capacity \& Capability Planning: Direct capacity planning, identify and resolve shop floor level bottlenecks through technical process optimization.
* Operational: Establish and refine standard operating rhythms, ensuring compliance and performance visibility across all manufacturing shifts.
* Drive 5S implementation and sustain workplace organization.
* Support line readiness for new product introduction or process changes.
* Drive operators for continuous improvement and 5S.
* Establish daily operating rhythms in manufacturing.


**Desired Skills**
* Good Communication and Interpersonal Skill.
* Good analytical and data interpretation skills to monitor performance and identify improvement opportunities
* Experience in ERP / SAP
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience in Lean Manufacturing.
* Decision\-making/problem solving skills.
* Experience with structured quality improvement tools such as RCA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, 8D, PFMEA, SPC, and Control Plans.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics or Mechanical Engineering (Advanced degree or MBA/Operations Management certification is a plus).
* Experience: 8\-10\+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Kitchen Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, working across multiple Indian states including Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. The organization serves communities through initiatives in education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare, reaching over 1 million beneficiaries. Sevalaya is professionally managed and guided by a dedicated Board of Trustees with diverse professional backgrounds, all committed to social development and community service. The culture emphasizes compassion, service, and integrity, offering team members an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to society. More information about Sevalaya’s activities and impact is shared regularly through its social media channels.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Kitchen Manager is responsible for overseeing daily kitchen operations at Sevalaya’s on\-site facility in Tiruvallur in a full\-time capacity. This role includes planning menus, supervising food preparation and cooking, and ensuring meals are nutritious, hygienic, and timely for all beneficiaries. The Kitchen Manager will manage kitchen staff schedules, coordinate procurement and inventory of ingredients and supplies, and maintain compliance with food safety and sanitation standards. The role involves monitoring food quality and portion control, optimizing kitchen workflows, and collaborating with program teams to align meal plans with organizational needs. The Kitchen Manager also supports cost control, record\-keeping, and continuous improvement of kitchen processes to ensure efficient and compassionate service.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to manage food preparation and cooking activities, ensuring consistency and efficiency in daily operations.
* Knowledge of food \& beverage operations and food quality standards, with a focus on hygiene and nutrition.
* Experience in culinary management, including menu planning, staff supervision, and kitchen workflow optimization.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail in inventory control and documentation.
* Understanding of food safety regulations and best practices in sanitation and safe food handling.
* Effective communication and people management skills, with the ability to lead and train a diverse kitchen team.
* Prior experience in large\-scale or institutional kitchens, community kitchens, or non\-profit settings is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in relevant local languages and comfort working in a rural or semi\-urban environment.
* Commitment to Sevalaya’s values of service, inclusivity, and respect, and willingness to work on\-site in Tiruvallur.

title: Manager - Purchase & Procurement
description:
**Company Description** 
 Golden Coir Tufts is a manufacturing and export company based in Pollachi, India, specializing in private\-label coir, rubber, and hybrid entrance mats for global retail and brand partners. The company operates on a six\-acre integrated campus that brings together product development, printing, backing, finishing, inspection, and export packing. With an annual production capacity of around five million mats, Golden Coir Tufts supports large\-scale, high\-quality, and timely deliveries. Team members work in a setting that blends traditional material expertise with modern manufacturing practices and international quality standards.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 The Manager – Purchase \& Procurement will be responsible for end\-to\-end procurement activities for Golden Coir Tufts’ manufacturing operations. The role will manage sourcing, supplier development, commercial negotiations, purchase planning and timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, chemicals, consumables, engineering spares and other production requirements.
 



  





 The position will work closely with Production, Planning, Stores, Quality, Accounts and Management to ensure uninterrupted material availability while maintaining optimum inventory levels and procurement costs.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include supplier identification and evaluation, RFQ comparison, price and payment\-term negotiation, purchase order management, delivery follow\-up, alternate vendor development, supplier performance monitoring and cost\-reduction initiatives.
 



  





 The role will also monitor material requirements against production plans, lead times and inventory levels; address supplier quality or delivery issues; maintain approved vendor records; and ensure purchasing activities are accurately recorded through the company’s ERP system.
 



  





 The Manager will be expected to continuously identify opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, alternate sourcing, improved payment terms, reduced lead times and better procurement controls.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 \* 5\+ years of procurement/purchasing experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
 



 \* Strong experience in vendor development, RFQ comparison, commercial negotiation and supplier performance management.
 



 \* Experience procuring raw materials, chemicals, polymers/rubber/PVC\-related materials, packaging, consumables or engineering spares is advantageous.
 



 \* Strong understanding of MRP/material planning, stock levels, reorder planning and production\-driven procurement.
 



 \* Proven ability to negotiate pricing, credit/payment terms, MOQ, lead times and supply contracts.
 



 \* Experience working with ERP\-based purchasing, PO, GRN and inventory workflows.
 



 \* Strong Excel/data\-analysis capability for purchase\-price analysis, consumption trends and cost\-saving analysis.
 



 \* Experience handling supplier quality issues, shortages and urgent production requirements.
 



 \* Experience in an export\-oriented manufacturing company is preferred.
 



 \* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
 



 \* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Tamil communication capability would be useful for local supplier coordination.

title: Assistant Manager, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Assistant Manager, Accounts Receivable is responsible for the management of the accounts receivable (“AR”) of Ventra Health's clients. This person works closely with the Director, Revenue Cycle Management (“Director, RCM”) in overseeing operational processes, personnel, and administrative functions in order to provide superior AR management services. This position ensures client satisfaction by executing the strategic business plan while leading their team .


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Partners with the Director RCM to ensures appropriate staffing levels and balance of workload for the AR team and participates in the hiring process
* Responsible for consistent and ongoing training of AR team
* Performs routine audits and holds monthly/quarterly one\-on\-one reviews with AR team members
* Serves as a resource of knowledge and guidance for the AR team
* Develops time management and organizational skills in the AR team to ensure they accomplish their productivity goals each week
* Ensures client performance meets or exceeds Ventra Health standards
* Ensures that accurate and up\-to date instructions surrounding the AR processes are maintained for each assigned client and clearly communicated in a timely manner
* Leads team of accounts receivable specialists that are responsible for the following;
* Maintaining appropriate days in AR
* Maintaining percent of AR over 120 days
* Maintaining appropriate percent with credit balances
* Maintaining appropriate percent of accounts sent to collections
* Ensures timely month end close for all assigned clients
* Drives standardization (“One Ventra Health”) of accounts receivable processes including proper documentation, distribution, and communication
* Partners with shared services to ensure proper management of client processes to include timely processing charge/payment/adjustment batches
* Supports implementation of follow\-up processes with off\-shore resources
* Communicates AR performance and payer issues/trends to Director(s), RCM timely
* Supports a positive workplace culture to attract and retain revenue cycle talent on assigned client(s)
* Supports the “One Ventra Health” model as it relates to changes in the revenue cycle management processes
* Understands and complies with applicable laws regarding billing, collections, and refund processing
* Communicates employee performance to Director(s), RCM and HR


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma
* Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Benefits, or related field, preferred, or equivalent training and/or experience
* At least five (5\) years of revenue cycle management experience or account receivables in the healthcare and/or health insurance industry
* At least two (2\) years of supervisory/management/leadership experience, preferred
* BPO Billing experience preferred


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Strong working knowledge of revenue cycle metrics
* Working knowledge of medical billing requirements
* Knowledge of business and financial processes, procedures, and processes
* Strong supervisory/management skills
* Strong management level oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong financial reporting skills
* Strong healthcare data analysis skills
* Strong presentation development and delivery skills
* Strong word processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation software skills
* Strong decision\-making skills
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong time management skills
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Strong mathematical skills, in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of whole numbers and fractions; computing percentages; and working with decimals
* Ability to effectively present information, including financial reporting and healthcare analytics, and respond to questions from groups of executives and managers
* Ability to adapt communication style to suit different audiences
* Ability to communicate with business stakeholders and IT staff in a tactful, mature, and professional manner
* Ability to lead and manage cross\-functional teams
* Ability to initiate and maintain professional relationships.
* Ability to see reoccurring issues and fix them or identify and solve front\-end issues
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Apporte une expertise technique et développe des solutions techniques (configuration, estimation des performances, économie, etc.) dans le cadre du processus pré\-ITO (demande d'achat) tout en assurant l'interface avec l'équipe commerciale. Possède une compréhension approfondie des marchés pertinents et de la valeur économique des clients, ce qui contribue à des stratégies d'adjudication gagnantes. Pour inclure « ITO » : Analyse technique du besoin client : définition et optimisation des produits ; du cadre (description) ; du programme ; du schéma industriel ; des coûts, compte tenu des contrats et politiques internes ainsi que des procédures. Calcul des performances et de l'efficacité des installations, des systèmes et des équipements. Documentation des spécifications techniques et des éléments de coût pour les phases ultérieures d'exécution du contrat. Cela inclut également la partie OTR (« de la commande jusqu'au versement ») où les ingénieurs s'emploient à personnaliser les produits et à les implémenter en fonction des besoins spécifiques des clients.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich zu erfüllen Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und \-verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Bietet technisches Know\-how und entwickelt technische Lösungen (Konfiguration, Leistungsschätzung, Wirtschaftlichkeit usw.) im Rahmen des Pre\-ITO\-Prozesses (Beschaffung), und fungiert gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle zum kaufmännischen Team. Verfügt über fundiertes Wissen über die relevanten Märkte und des wirtschaftlichen Werts der Kunden, was zur Gewinnung von Gebotsstrategien beiträgt. Einschließen von "ITO": Technische Analyse des Kundenbedarfs: Definition und Optimierung der Produkte; Umfang (Beschreibung); Zeitplan; industrielle Regelung; Kosten unter Berücksichtigung der vertraglichen und internen Richtlinien und Verfahren. Berechnung der Leistung und Effizienz von Anlagen, Systemen und Ausrüstung. Dokumentation von technischen Spezifikationen und Kalkulationselementen für weitere Phasen der Vertragsabwicklung. Dazu gehört auch der OTR\-Teil, in dem die Ingenieure daran arbeiten, die Produkte anzupassen und für bestimmte Kundenanforderungen umzusetzen
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Quality Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero\-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data\-driven decision\-making, and disciplined problem\-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high\-performing quality organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world\-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards.
* Champion zero\-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations.
* Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem\-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns.
* Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability.
* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and visibility across the organization.
* Develop and coach a high\-performing quality team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, regulatory, and customer requirements while promoting operational discipline and best practices.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in Quality Management within a Tier\-1 automotive manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in welding and assembly manufacturing processes and quality management systems.
* Proven experience in customer quality management, audit management, complaint handling, and corrective action implementation.
* Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and core quality tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience driving defect reductionand continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders to achieve quality and business objectives.
* Proficiency in interpreting customer requirements, regulatory standards, and quality system expectations.
* Effective communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a strong ownership mindset and customer focus.
* Relevant quality certifications and automotive quality credentials are preferred.

title: VMC Operator
description:
Purpose
   

  

 The Shift Leader \- CNC Machining is responsible for the hands\-on manufacturing of precision mould and fixture components using VMC machines. The role ensures achievement of quality, productivity, cost, and delivery targets while maximizing machine utilization and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
   

  

 Key Responsibility
   

  

**CNC Machining Operations**
* Operate and manage 3\-axis and 5\-axis VMC machines with FANUC, Siemens, and Heidenhain controls.
* Ensure productivity, quality, cost, and delivery targets are achieved.
* Train operators on CNC programming, machine functions, macros, and command instructions.
* Perform machine setup, tool offset setting, and work coordinate configuration.
* Interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, and technical specifications.
* Optimize machining processes, tooling selection, cutting parameters, and cycle times.
* Guide CAM programmers for effective machining strategies.
* Monitor machine loading, utilization, and machine availability


**Production Monitoring \& Quality Control**
* Supervise operators and support inspection of finished components.
* Ensure production and quality logs are accurately maintained.
* Monitor utilization, First Time Through (FTT), rejection, and rework metrics.
* Maintain CNC programs, tooling sheets, and setup documentation revisions.
* Escalate equipment calibration requirements when required.
* Drive actions to improve process capability and quality performance.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Coordinate with Process Planning, CAM Programming, Quality, Assembly, and Production teams.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for machining defects, rework, and rejection cases.
* Issue and monitor job cards and routing sheets for traceability.
* Provide production timelines based on capacity and resource availability.
* Resolve machining and assembly\-related issues through cross\-functional collaboration.
* Support continuous improvement, productivity enhancement, and cost\-reduction projects.
* Ensure adherence to safety, quality, and operational standards.


**Safety, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**
